description: SEC R&D spending profile — Research and development profile for a US public company: last 5 fiscal years of R&D expense and revenue from SEC XBRL company facts, R&D intensity (% of revenue), year-over-year R&D growth, 3-year R&D vs revenue CAGR with a trend verdict, acquired in-process R&D, a VERY_HIGH/HIGH/MODERATE/LOW intensity level, plus 10-K text: R&D focus statements, themes (AI, cloud, semiconductors, clinical development...), change drivers and headcount statements. Params: ticker (or cik); optional filing=1 for the prior 10-K text. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_rd_profile
